This function checks the JTAG device state change.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks the DAP security-gate state change.

para.verbatim: When Secure gate is opened from close state this API raises an error, if the gate is closed and re-opened again this function recognizes the state change and performs the action configured.

parameterdescription.para: is of pointer of void type.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success and error code on failure

para.verbatim: When Secure gate is opened from close state this API raises an error, if the gate is closed and re-opened again this function recognizes the state change and performs the action configured. Versal_2VP_P has no JTAG_STATUS_0; open is DAP_SECURITY == 0xFFFFFFFF, the same value XLoader_EnableJtag writes (including PLM_AUTH_JTAG unlock). On HWRoT boot the first CLOSE-to-OPEN edge raises SW error 0x8E (XIL_EVENT_ERROR_MASK_DEV_STATE_CHANGE). Default EAM action is XPLMI_EM_ACTION_NONE; EM_SET_ACTION can escalate it.

parameterdescription.para: is of pointer of void type.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success and error code on failure
